COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS 2516/2022
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Ms. Indu Sharma, Advocate, for the 
petitioner.
Respondent is on caveat,
represented by Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate. 
Mr. Pant prays for and is granted 
three weeks’ time for filing counter 
affidavit. 
List on 16.12.2022.
Till the next date of listing, 
execution of the impugned award shall 
remain stayed provided petitioner deposits 
50 per cent of the amount, due to the 
respondent in terms of the impugned award 
before the Labour Court concerned, within 
four weeks from today. Amount, if 
deposited, may be released in favour of 
respondent without asking for any security. 
In case petitioner fails to deposit the 
aforesaid amount within stipulated time, 
then this order shall stand vacated 
automatically. 
Stay application (IA/1/2022) stands 
disposed of accordingly. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 14.10..2022
Pr
